scope: Bounded primary-study cache covering established treatments, previous shortlist ingredients, and additional interventional or symptomatic trials. Ingredients without verified administration have unknown testing status. Coverage is not a census of ALS research.

studies.title: A controlled trial of riluzole in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. ALS/Riluzole Study Group.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Riluzole. Survival favored riluzole.
studies.result: Survival favored riluzole.

studies.title: Safety and efficacy of edaravone in well defined patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Edaravone. Less ALSFRS-R decline in this selected population.
studies.result: Less ALSFRS-R decline in this selected population.

studies.title: Trial of Antisense Oligonucleotide Tofersen for SOD1 ALS.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Tofersen. No significant clinical benefit at 28 weeks. Biomarkers fell.
studies.result: No significant clinical benefit at 28 weeks. Biomarkers fell.

studies.title: Safety and efficacy of arimoclomol in patients with early amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ORARIALS-01): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre, phase 3 trial.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Arimoclomol. No improvement in combined function and survival.
studies.result: No improvement in combined function and survival.

studies.title: Randomized, double-blind, controlled trial of acetylcysteine in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Acetylcysteine. No significant overall survival or progression benefit.
studies.result: No significant overall survival or progression benefit.

studies.title: A randomized sequential trial of creatine in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Creatine. No survival or functional benefit.
studies.result: No survival or functional benefit.

studies.title: Safety and efficacy of trehalose in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (HEALEY ALS Platform Trial): an adaptive, phase 2/3, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Trehalose. No evidence of slower disease progression.
studies.result: No evidence of slower disease progression.

studies.title: A 40-week phase 2B randomized, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled study evaluating the safety and efficacy of memantine in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Memantine. No difference in progression or measured biomarkers.
studies.result: No difference in progression or measured biomarkers.

studies.title: Safety and efficacy of memantine and trazodone versus placebo for motor neuron disease (MND SMART): stage two interim analysis from the first cycle of a phase 3, multiarm, multistage, randomised, adaptive platform trial.
studies.formulation: Oral trazodone in a separate randomized arm from memantine and placebo
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Trazodone. Interim analysis found no efficacy benefit.
studies.result: Interim analysis found no efficacy benefit.

studies.title: Safety and efficacy of ceftriaxone for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a multi-stage, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Ceftriaxone. Phase 3 did not demonstrate efficacy.
studies.result: Phase 3 did not demonstrate efficacy.

studies.title: Efficacy of minocycline in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a phase III randomised trial.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Minocycline. ALSFRS-R declined significantly faster on minocycline.
studies.result: ALSFRS-R declined significantly faster on minocycline.

studies.title: Trial of celecoxib in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Celecoxib. No measured functional or survival benefit.
studies.result: No measured functional or survival benefit.

studies.title: Mexiletine for muscle cramps in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: A randomized, double-blind crossover trial.
studies.population: People with ALS and symptomatic cramps
studies.formulation: Mexiletine 150 mg twice daily in a placebo-controlled crossover
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Mexiletine. Fewer muscle cramps. Disease modification was not tested.
studies.result: Fewer muscle cramps. Disease modification was not tested.

studies.title: Phase III randomized trial of gabapentin in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Gabapentin. No strength, survival or functional benefit.
studies.result: No strength, survival or functional benefit.

studies.title: A randomized, placebo-controlled trial of topiramate in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Topiramate. Faster measured strength decline and increased adverse events.
studies.result: Faster measured strength decline and increased adverse events.

studies.title: Safety and efficacy of rasagiline as an add-on therapy to riluzole in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a randomised, double-blind, parallel-group, placebo-controlled, phase 2 trial.
studies.formulation: Rasagiline added to riluzole versus placebo plus riluzole
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Rasagiline. No significant difference in primary survival outcome.
studies.result: No significant difference in primary survival outcome.

studies.title: A randomized, double blind, placebo-controlled trial of pioglitazone in combination with riluzole in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
studies.formulation: Pioglitazone added to riluzole versus placebo plus riluzole
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Pioglitazone. Stopped for futility. No survival improvement.
studies.result: Stopped for futility. No survival improvement.

studies.title: Reduced oxidative damage in ALS by high-dose enteral melatonin treatment.
studies.population: People with ALS receiving chronic melatonin
studies.formulation: Rectal melatonin 300 mg daily in human safety study
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Melatonin. Tolerability and an oxidative biomarker reported. Clinical efficacy undetermined.
studies.result: Tolerability and an oxidative biomarker reported. Clinical efficacy undetermined.

studies.title: Open-label pilot trial of levetiracetam for cramps and spasticity in patients with motor neuron disease.
studies.population: Motor neuron disease cohort including ALS
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Levetiracetam. Cramp measures improved in this uncontrolled symptomatic study.
studies.result: Cramp measures improved in this uncontrolled symptomatic study.

studies.title: Dexpramipexole versus placebo for patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (EMPOWER): a randomised, double-blind, phase 3 trial.
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report on-treatment observations for Dexpramipexole. No difference in the primary combined function and survival outcome.
studies.result: No difference in the primary combined function and survival outcome.

studies.title: Minocycline in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a pilot study
studies.formulation: Minocycline plus riluzole versus riluzole alone over six months
studies.administration_evidence: The authors administered riluzole in both arms and minocycline in the combination arm and followed adverse effects.
studies.result: Pilot tolerability findings under coadministration do not establish disease-modifying efficacy.

studies.title: Pridopidine in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: The HEALEY ALS Platform Trial
studies.population: People with ALS in a randomized platform regimen
studies.formulation: Oral pridopidine 45 mg twice daily versus placebo for 24 weeks
studies.administration_evidence: The investigators report participants treated in the active and placebo arms.
studies.result: No significant benefit on joint function and survival. Disease rate ratio 0.99 (95% credible interval 0.80 to 1.21).

formulation_checks.reason: The ALS pilot did not establish administration of zinc chloride, zinc acetate or elemental zinc metal.
